South Kendall Sunblazer

Soccer Club · Miami, Florida · Fall 2026 Season

Every Sunblazer team registered for the fall league season, in one place. Open any team's page below for its record, results, fixtures, league table and match preview show — all of it compiled and kept current by the club.

Boys

The U-9, U-10, U-11, U-12, U-13, U-15 and U-16 boys play in the club’s fall league season; the U-14 boys play in the South Flight 1.

Girls · Fall 2026

Everything on this hub is compiled by the club from season records and kept current week by week — the same source for every team page.

The Sunblazer boys teams play in the club's fall league season; the U-14 boys play in the South Flight 1. The club's girls teams play in their own fall girls league.

An SK 14 GOLD side also appeared in the 2026 Region A Commissioner's Cup, but it is not in this fall's league list.

Club site: sksoccer.org

How this hub is put together

The scores, standings, fixtures and previews on this hub are compiled from many sources and confirmed before they go up — league records, information and reports from the teams themselves, and word from coaches and club families. We gather it from a bunch of different places and do the legwork, so everything you need to follow the season lives in one place.

See something off? Tell us and we will fix it.
